headline: Vaelet Purification of Gaia
title: Vaelet | Purification of Gaia More Drops From Ground Pals | Palworld Guide
video_script: Farming Ground Pals for loot? Bring Vaelet. Its partner skill, Purification of Gaia, makes Ground Pals drop forty to eighty percent more items when you defeat them, and it does not stack. At base it is a six job worker, with Planting, Handiwork, Gathering and Medicine Production all at level three. Does Vaelet work at your base? Comment below!
description: Vaelet in Palworld 1.0: Purification of Gaia boosts drops from Ground Pals by 40 to 80 percent, and it works four jobs at level three.
